avis.titre: Be careful with what moisturizer you use
avis.texte: These pads were good in the beginning (1-3 days) and I love the first two times I used them. This is obviously not an everyday use, as the AHA can cause purging and strip your skin if used too frequently. After the third time I used them, I noticed I had thick cystic acne appearing mainly in my cheeks and chin. I have combo mostly dry skin, so having acne in these areas isn't all that new. I switched my moisturizer from the La Roche Posay no SPF to Tatcha water cream when using this and the acne went away. I've noticed that if you use any thick or medium thickness moisturizer, it will give you cystic acne like no tomorrow. Be vary wary of fragrances too as I got chemical burns from using this with other moisturizers as well and it is not from misuse as I have been using AHAs for years with these moisturizers and haven't had these issues. Could be from a higher concentration in this product, but overall would not repurchase.

avis.titre: Definitely keeping this in my skin routine

PHA is one of the most gentle acids making it the most suitable for rosacea. I have combo skin and need a nice exfoliation for my t-zone so I use the scrubber side of the oad for that thwn gently sweep the smooth side over my cheeks just once and this leaves me GLOWING and my skin irritation free!! plus PHA being water soluble means it's great for dry skin which makes this ideal for winter! A fantastic product!

avis.texte: I've been hearing so much buzz about ANUA, and the Heartleaf 77 Clear Pad was the first product I've had the pleasure of trying and it did not disappoint! First off, the packaging is brilliant. The built-in tweezers are a game-changer for sanitary product dispensing. No more dipping my fingers into the jar! These toner pads are soaked in a gentle, calming formula with 77% heartleaf extract, known for its soothing and anti-inflammatory properties. avis.titre: A treat when added to an existing routine

However, I wouldn't rely on these pads as your sole exfoliant, as their exfoliating effect is quite gentle. These pads provide a mild level of exfoliation, so they complement other products in your routine rather than replace them. The essence is another standout feature. It's refreshing and soothing, which is especially appreciated by someone like me with dehydrated skin. While I did see slight improvement in hydration, it wasn't a dramatic change. Overall, I recommend these pads as a nice addition to an established skincare routine. They're not a miracle product, but they work well when paired with other treatments.

Anua's Heartleaf 77 Clear Pad is a great option for a mild daily exfoliation. I adore how soft the ANUA Heartleaf 77 clear pads make my skin feel with continued use, my skin was smoother and brighter. I have combination skin and I am always looking for ways to help my skin be clearer. The anua heartleaf pads have been a great addition to my routine. I had already tried some anua products and I have really liked the clear pads. The packaging is very nice looking and I really liked the way that they came clearly sealed to keep the moisture in. The package comes with small tweezers that are very useful to pick the thin pads. Once I washed my face I used the pad to gently exfoliate my face and neck, one pad does the job perfectly. The pads do not have any scent, and they are great for a quick and gentle exfoliation, that can be followed by the anua toner or any other toner. I did notice that my face felt softer and it has helped my skin look fresher.

These Anua Heartleaf 77 Clear Pad + PHA have been wonderful! I've used this exfoliating toner pad once a day, every night, for about a week now, and never had an issue with irritation. Having dry skin is one of my problems. After using this exfoliating toner, I can tell that my skin is much softer, clearer, and hydrated. This has helped maintain skin moisture while it cleanses residue and removes dead skin cells. I just gently wiped the embossed side to exfoliate and pat the other side of the pad to ensure enough absorption best result. The tweezer included in the packaging is a plus. It makes it easier to grab and separate them without contaminating the other pads. I will keep on using this clear pad for two weeks or more to get the improvement I am waiting for.

So I'm obsessed with centella asiatica in my skincare products. The ingredients list for this Anua Heartleaf 77 + PHA toner pads looks amazing. It even ended up getting a 100 out of 100 on an ingredient checker app that I use all the time. Everything on paper is perfect but I had to take away one star for a minor setback. I love that these are super saturated pads that come with tongs to get out so you don't have to worry about bacteria from your fingers. I also love that they don't strip my dry combo skin barrier. The setback is what happens after I use them. I noticed that my skin feels hydrated but slightly tacky. When I take my finger and rub it against my cheek it either pills a little bit of remaining product on my face or my dead skin cells or both. Again, it's not a deal breaker, I just wish all of the exfoliation could happen while using the toner pads instead of afterwards. I know these are exfoliating toner pads and I think that's great for the most part, I just don't love when my face feels a little tacky afterwards. Maybe the solution is to wipe my face with a wet cloth so that no residue is left behind. Other than that, I really like how these toner pads get a bunch of gunk and dirt off of my face. Even though they're not perfect, I would still recommend them to my family and friends.

These Anua toner pads make it super simple to use them and apply to your face. Having toner pre-applied on the pad means you can grab and go without needing to add to your hand or a cotton ball, and the included tweezers (and the seamless way they fit into the container) make it easier than having to grab the pad by hand. The toner pads have a pleasant scent to them, a fairly natural scent (maybe pine or citrus) that isn't overpowering and doesn't smell artificial at all. My face definitely feels a nice tingle after use, and I do see a difference in the hydration and glow on my skin after use. The container feels very premium and the instructions to use are clear (and very simple). I'll definitely continue to use these as part of my skin care routine!

It is very lightweight and absorbs within seconds. I do wish that the cotton pads used in the product were a bit softer. I found them to be quite rough and abrasive and having sensitive skin, I don't tend to use physical exfoliators. After using this product for a week, I started to notice some small red bumps covering most of my face. I hadn't switched or added anything else in my skincare routine during that time so I have to assume that the heart leaf pads are what caused it. I may try just dabbing the pads on my face instead of rubbing them in to see if that prevents the irritation.

I have tried a few other toner pads and find then to in general be more drying which isn't necessarily a bad thing as I have oily skin. So I was very surprised by how well these hydrated my skin. Even after cleansing the skin, this adds moisture instead of taking it away. My skin also gets reds whenever I rub on skincare but it didn't with these pads which shows me how truly soothing they are. I love the pad format because it's so convenient. These come with so many pads and they are super saturated. I also feel very fancy using the tweezers and I think they would be helpful for people with really short or really long nails. I'm so excited to see that this brand is now available at Ulta. Even better news, this is considered to be "non prestige" so you can use the $3.50 off coupons on it!

I recently tried the Anua Toner Pads, and I couldn't be happier with the results! These pads are incredibly gentle on my skin yet effective at exfoliating dead skin cells. After just two weeks of consistent use, I noticed a visible improvement—my pores looked significantly smaller, just as promised! The hypoallergenic formula is perfect for my sensitive skin, and the watery texture leaves a refreshing, non-sticky finish. If you're looking for a product that delivers on its claims, this is it. As someone who is prone to breakouts, the Anua Heartleaf Clear Pads were exactly what I was needing! I loved using these pads as a little way to wake myself up in the morning. I think it is a great product with an affordable price and I can see myself keeping this in my skincare routine.

Received complimentary for review. The ANUA Hearleaf 77 Clear Pads are amazing. I will start by saying that I have dry maturing skin and these felt absolutely amazing. Anua is the first Korean skincare brand I've ever tried, and it has quickly become my absolute favorite since 2022. The Heartleaf 77 Clear Pad is a game-changer for my oily skin type. The heartleaf extract in the formula is incredibly calming, and the lightweight texture ensures my skin feels refreshed and never sticky. For anyone looking for a versatile and reliable skincare product, this is it. ANUA has truly set the bar high for me when it comes to Korean skincare!

After just one use, I already noticed a big difference in my skin and after incorporating it in my routine on a regular basis my skin has become transformed. I'm shocked at how affordable this product is because it performs better than high-end brands. If you want quality skincare but are on a budget, I can't recommend this enough, especially if you have sensitive skin. I was gifted this product in exchange for my honest feedback.

I think this is a great toner for sensitive skin types. It helps to gently exfoliate while providing hydration and soothing care to your skin. This doesn't have any extra irritants or harsh ingredients for brightening like many other toners on the market. As far as acne it helps soothe but thats it this is a great in between step to help your serums and moisturizer sink in deeper to the skin.

avis.titre: This has to be my new go-to toner
avis.texte: Okay if I'm being honest I was sure if i would really like these toner pads. I have been using them daily after cleansing my face in the morning at night. avis.titre: A Simplification of a Usually Messy Skincare Step
avis.texte: The ANUA Heartleaf Toner pad was a great way for me to include a toner into my routine without the fuss. The target of this Toner + Pad duo was to combine the benefits of both a hydrating Toner & Exfoliation by effectively trying to make possible that more reactive skin types get the benefits of exfoliation. The key ingredients of PHAs(PolyHydroxy Acids), Heartleaf, and Madecassoside aimed to give a gentle but effective exfoliating experience. The pads themselves don't carry a lot of product; but if you tip the container upside down then they'll be an even distribution of product on the most immediate pads. I used this every two days, because while the molecular weight of the exfoliating agents are larger than say your more known BHAs & AHAs. You can still overdo it especially with the added element of the physical property of the pad itself if you don't rub gently enough. The product on application leaves a tacky feel that I disliked, even so it doesn't interfere with follow up skin care steps. I'm using this my skin did get a reduction of redness from a new pimple. It immediately soothed the inflammation around my pimple and the texture (from old pitted scars/pores) was still there but slightly less obvious. I've been using this on my cheeks/neck/hands for the last week. In doing so I did notice I got Closed Comedones on my chin + cheeks. So I would say if you're prone to that test this out as there are fatty alcohols in here.
